info.title: The WiX Toolset command-line interface.
info.description: The WiX Toolset lets developers create installers for Windows. This package contains the WiX Toolset command-line interface.

commands.name: build
commands.description: Build a wixlib, package, or bundle.

options.name: -arch
options.description: Set the architecture of the output.

options.name: -bcgg
options.description: Backward compatible GUID generation with WiX v3.

options.name: -bindfiles
options.description: Bind files into an output .wixlib. Ignored if not building a .wixlib.

options.name: -bindpath
options.description: Bind path to search for content files.

options.name: -cabcache
options.description: Set a folder to cache cabinets across builds.

options.name: -cabthreads
options.description: Override the number of threads used to create cabinets.

options.name: -culture
options.description: Adds a culture to filter localization files.

options.name: -define
options.description:
Sets a preprocessor variable.
-dcl|-defaultcompressionlevel Default compression level; see Compression levels below.

options.name: -includepath
options.description:
Folder to search for include files.
-intermediatefolder Optional working folder. If not specified a folder in %TMP% will be created.

options.name: -loc
options.description: Localization file to use in the build. By default, .wxl files are recognized as localization.

options.name: -lib
options.description: Library file to use in the build. By default, .wixlib files are recognized as libraries.

options.name: -src
options.description: Source file to use in the build. By default, .wxs files are recognized as source code.

options.name: -nostdlib
options.description: Skip use of WiX standard wixlib.

options.name: -out
options.description: Path to output the build to.

options.name: -outputtype
options.description: Explicitly set the output type if it cannot be determined from the output.

options.name: -pdb
options.description: Optional path to output .wixpdb. Default will write .wixpdb beside output path.

options.name: -pdbtype
options.description:
Switch to disable creation of .wixpdb. Types: full or none.
Compression levels:
none        Use no compression
low         Use low compression
medium      Use medium compression
high        Use high compression
mszip       Use ms-zip compression
For more information see: http://wixtoolset.org/

commands.name: burn
commands.description: Specialized operations for manipulating Burn-based bundles.

commands.name: detach
commands.description: Detaches the Burn engine from a bundle so it can be signed.

options.name: -engine
options.description:
Path for extracted bundle engine.
For more information see: http://wixtoolset.org/

commands.name: extract
commands.description: Extracts the contents of a bundle.

options.name: -outba
options.description: Folder to extract the bundle bootstrapper application to.

options.name: -out
options.description:
Folder to extract the bundle contents to.
For more information see: http://wixtoolset.org/

commands.name: reattach
commands.description: Reattaches a signed burn engine to a bundle.

options.name: -engine
options.description:
Burn engine extracted using `wix burn detach` and then signed.
-intermediateFolder Optional working folder. If not specified %TMP% will be used.

options.name: -out
options.description:
path to output bundle with reattached signed engine that can then be signed as a whole.
For more information see: http://wixtoolset.org/

commands.name: remotepayload
commands.description: Generate source code for a remote payload.

options.name: -basepath
options.description:
Folder as base to make payloads relative.
-bundlepayloadgeneration Sets the package payload generation option; available types are: none, externalwithoutdownloadurl, external, all.

options.name: -downloadurl
options.description: Set the DownloadUrl attribute on the generated payloads.

options.name: -out
options.description: Path to output the source code file.

options.name: -recurse
options.description:
Generate source code for all payloads in directory recursively.
-intermediatefolder Optional working folder. If not specified %TMP% folder will be created.

options.name: -packagetype
options.description: Explicitly set package type; available types are: _bundle_, _exe_, _msu_.

options.name: -usecertificate
options.description:
Use certificate to validate signed payloads. This option is not recommended.
For more information see: http://wixtoolset.org/

commands.name: convert
commands.description: Convert v3 source code to v4 source code.

options.name: --custom-table
options.description: Convert custom table authoring for use in MSI packages (msi) or bundles (bundle).

options.name: --dry-run
options.description: Only display errors, do not update files.

options.name: --recurse
options.description: Search for matching files in current dir and subdirs.

options.name: -set1
options.description: Primary settings file.

options.name: -set2
options.description: Secondary settings file (overrides primary).

options.name: -indent
options.description:
Indentation multiple (overrides default of 4).
sourceFile may use wildcards like *.wxs
For more information see: http://wixtoolset.org/

options.name: --global
options.description: Add/remove the extension for the current user.

commands.name: format
commands.description: Ensure consistent formatting of source code.

options.name: --dry-run
options.description: Only display errors, do not update files.

options.name: --recurse
options.description: Search for matching files in current dir and subdirs.

options.name: -set1
options.description: Primary settings file.

options.name: -set2
options.description: Secondary settings file (overrides primary).

options.name: -indent
options.description:
Indentation multiple (overrides default of 4).
sourceFile may use wildcards like *.wxs
For more information see: http://wixtoolset.org/

commands.name: msi
commands.description: Specialized operations for manipulating Windows Installer databases.

commands.name: decompile
commands.description: Converts a Windows Installer database back into source code.

options.name: -data
options.description: Save output as WiX data instead of as a source file.

options.name: -sct
options.description: Suppress decompiling custom tables.

options.name: -sdet
options.description: Suppress dropping empty tables.

options.name: -sras
options.description: Suppress relative action sequencing.

options.name: -sui
options.description: Suppress decompiling UI tables.

options.name: -type
options.description:
Optionally specify the input file type: msi or msm. If not specified, type will be inferred by file extension.
-intermediateFolder Optional working folder. If not specified, %TMP% will be used.

options.name: -out
options.description: Optional path for the decompiled output file. If not specified, output path will have the same base name as the input file in the same directory.

options.name: -x
options.description:
If specified, export embedded binaries and icons to specified folder.
For more information see: http://wixtoolset.org/

commands.name: inscribe
commands.description: Updates MSI database with cabinet signature information.

options.name: -out
options.description:
Path to output the inscribed MSI. If not provided, the input MSI is updated in place.
For more information see: http://wixtoolset.org/

options.name: -p
options.description: Preserve unchanged rows.

options.name: -pedantic
options.description: Show pedantic messages.

options.name: -serr
options.description: Suppress error when applying transform; see Error flags below.

options.name: -t
options.description: Use default validation flags for the transform type; see Transform types below.

options.name: -val
options.description: Validation flags for the transform; see Validation flags below.

options.name: -x
options.description: Folder to extract binaries.

options.name: -xo
options.description: Output transfrom as a WiX output instead of an MST file.

options.name: -out
options.description:
Path to output the transform file.
Error flags:
a          Ignore errors when adding an existing row
b          Ignore errors when deleting a missing row
c          Ignore errors when adding an existing table
d          Ignore errors when deleting a missing table
e          Ignore errors when modifying a missing row
f          Ignore errors when changing the code page
Validation flags:
g          UpgradeCode must match
l          Language must match
r          Product ID must match
s          Check major version only
t          Check major and minor versions
u          Check major, minor, and upgrade versions
v          Upgrade version < target version
w          Upgrade version <= target version
x          Upgrade version = target version
y          Upgrade version > target version
z          Upgrade version >= target version
Transform types:
language   Default flags for a language transform
instance   Default flags for an instance transform
patch      Default flags for a patch transform
For more information see: http://wixtoolset.org/

commands.name: validate
commands.description: Validates MSI database using standard or custom ICEs.

options.name: -cub
options.description: Optional path to a custom validation .CUBe file.

options.name: -ice
options.description:
Validates only with the specified ICE. May be provided multiple times.
-intermediateFolder Optional working folder. If not specified %TMP% will be used.

options.name: -pdb
options.description: Optional path to .wixpdb for source line information. If not provided, will check next to the input file.

options.name: -sice
options.description:
Suppresses an ICE validator.
For more information see: http://wixtoolset.org/

options.name: --help
options.description: Show command line help.

options.name: --version
options.description: Display WiX Toolset version in use.

options.name: --nologo
options.description: Suppress displaying the logo information.
